content: Hessa gishshas intte dosettiza nayta mala Xoos misatite.
Kirstoosi nuna siiqida mala qasseka nu gishshas bana sawiza yarsho ooththi Xoossas immida mala intteka siiqon simerettite.
Laymay woykko tunateththi woykko uuzeteththi mulekka intte giddon beetoy attiin zigirsika siyettofo; hessa malay geeshsha Xoossa asas bessenna.
Intte galata galatizayta gidite attiin ase yeellachchiza laafa haasayay, coo eeyateththa yo7oy inttes bessontta gishshas hessa malay intte garsan dooppo.
Qasseka intte laymatizaytas woykko tunatas woykko uuzettizaytassinne eeqas goynnizaytas Kirstoosa kawoteththaninne Xoossa Kawoteththan isttas laatasoy bayndayssa intte erite.
Inttena oonikka wordo haasayan baleththofo; gaasoykka Xoossa hanqoy izas azazettontta nayta bolla yaanay haytantta malanna.
Hessa gishshas hessantta malara zuppetopite.
Kase intte dhuma shin Godaan ha7i intte poo7o; intte poo7o nayta mala diite.
Poo7os ayfey lo7eteththan, xilloteththaninne tumateththan ubbaan dees.
Hessaththoka Godaa ufayssiza miish koyite.
Ayfey baynda dhuma oosora inttes aykko gaagoteththi dooppo; hessafe iita ooso qoncce kessite.
Dhuman diza asati geeman ooththiza miishsha gishshas haasayaykka yeellachchees.
Poo7oy poo7idaazi wuri qonccen beettees.
Gaasoykka ubbaa bessizay poo7o; hessa gishshas,
Hessa gishshas erateththi bayndayta mala gidontta intte waanidi erata mala daanaakko naagettite.
Hayssi wodezi iita gidida gishshas hessa lo7eththi erite.
Hessa gishshas eeyata gidopite; Godaa sheney aazakko yuushshi qopite.
Ayanay kumidayta gidite attiin maththosiza ushshan maththottofte; hessi coo mela miishsha laaleththa.
Ayana yeththan galatara gaththi yexxishe intte giddon issoy issaara haasayettite; intte sabaninne yeththan kumeththa wozinappe Godaa galatite.
Hessan Xoossa Aawaa, Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa sunththaa ubba miishshas ubba wode galatite.
Machchonne Azina
Intte Kirstoosa bonchchos giidi yashshara issoy issaas azazettite.
Machcheto intte Godaas haarettiza mala intte azinatas haarettite.
Kirstoosi ba asho gidida Woosa Keeththays hu7e gidida mala azinaykka ba machcheys hu7e.
Hessa gishshas Woosa Keeththiya Kirstoosas azazettiza mala machchetikka ba azinatas ay hanonkka azazettanaas bessees.
Azinatoo! Kirstoosi Woosa Keeththayo siiqida malanne bana izi gishshas aaththi immida mala intteka intte machcheta siiqite.
Ba qaala baggara haaththan meecci geeshshi dummasides.
Hessaththoka qitay woykko ayfeso xirphoteththi woykko issi iitay izi bolla beettontta geeshshinne balay izi bolla bayndaaro bonchcho Woosa Keeththe histtidi shiishshanaassa.
Azinatikka hessaththo ba machcheta ba asho mala siiqanaas bessees; ba machcho siiqizaadey bana siiqees.
Barkka bana ixxizaadey oonikka deenna; ba ashos meessinne bana naagees; Kirstoosikka Woosa Keeththas hinniththo ooththides.
Nuni Kirstoosa asateththa.
Hessa gishshas, «Asi aayonne aawa aggidi ba machcheyra issino gidees; nam7ayka issi asho gideettes» geetetti Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettides.
Hayssi daro xuura yo7o; tanikka hayssa Kirstoosa gishshassinne Woosa Keeththa gishshas yootays.
Gidikkoka inttefe issi issaadey ba machcho bana siiqiza mala siiqo; machchaka ba azinaa bonchchu.
